title: The query log detects a false none from a routed answer's urls
goal: learn marks a logged lookup routed web whose answer cites a url that a root's _sources.csv holds (after url normalisation) as a false-none miss, written as a lookup_eval candidate like other misses, with no model call and no change to what the query log records or sends to the API.
notes: Deterministic; the url set is the answer text already stored in the row. Gate check: this changes no mode, redaction or API payload (always-blocking list); if the work finds it must, stop and raise a blocking gate.
